notes_for_editor: Thin record and doubtful identity. The only source is list row GA341 (datasheet tag). The same list has a Reynolds entry (GA423) in Clayton County at 33.596801,-84.349829, marked relocated. A 2012 Forest Fire Lookout Association report (https://firelookout.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/cr-restoration-2012.pdf) says a 100-foot Henry County tower was to be moved to Reynolds Nature Preserve near Morrow; it does not say the move happened. The Reynolds Nature Preserve Wikipedia page does not mention a tower. No source found ties the Lake Tara entry to any of these. The record is not in the cached NHLR or FFLOS Georgia folders, and live fetches of those sites failed with connection resets. Editor should check the list's datasheet and whether these coordinates are a separate tower or a mis-keyed Reynolds record before publishing. The list's elevation column has no unit on the page, so the story gives 950 without one; feet is likely but not stated. Fact-check pass 2026-10-21: removed the unstated feet and metre conversion, and reworded the 'Many were scrapped and sold' sentence. The story is about 134 words, a little over the 120-word target.
